title: [GMCP 203.028.M] Mastery: Secrets, credentials, and cryptographic lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-028-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: MCP credentials and private keys live in OS-backed secret storage or an explicit encrypted fallback, are referenced rather than copied into configs, and follow creation, least-scope, rotation, revocation, export prohibition and secure deletion policies. Secret scanning, redaction canaries and crash/core-dump tests prove secrets do not enter arguments, logs, traces, task files, environment inheritance or diagnostics. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
